about: BaseOnly in a Room Match: every launcher (launcher/room_modes.py) lists every GameModes/<mode>/Mode.json in <game>/ReBalanceOfSouls/gamemodes.txt; the room owner picks one on the Create room dialog's Game Mode row and gamemode.dll arms it for that room (the CharaStatus cells of CharaStatus.json, the flags below). 'rules' is what the Extras page Gamemodes rules shows: [title, text] pairs.
name: Base Only
rules: The base form's Fighting Spirit gauge is 0: nobody Awakens, the whole match is played in base form.
Aizen's base form timer (the wait before his cocoon form) never runs out.
rules_fr: La jauge de Fighting Spirit de la forme de base est à 0 : personne ne s'éveille, tout le match se joue en forme de base.
Aizen reste en forme de base
Le timer de la forme de base d'Aizen (avant sa forme cocon) ne finit jamais.
